When preserveValues=true: user value and enabled flag are kept for entries whose name matches a spec entry; spec entries missing from user are added with spec values; user entries not present in spec are dropped; duplicate names are paired positionally. When the mode differs, the spec auth object is returned. When the user's auth sub-object is null, the spec auth is returned. When preserveValues=false, the spec auth is returned (full overwrite, dropping user-only fields).

By default (sync mode): the URL is always taken from the spec; body, params, headers, and auth are merged preserving user values via their respective merge helpers; the script, tests, and assertions fields of the existing request are always preserved unchanged regardless of spec. When body mode changes the spec body wins outright. When options.preserveValues=false, spec values overwrite user values in body and params. I've implemented the OpenAPI sync helper functions in `packages/bruno-electron/src/ipc/openapi-sync.js`. Here's what I did:

## Summary

**Added new helpers:**
- `maskJsonInterpolations(jsonString)` — a character scanner that tracks in-string state (respecting backslash escapes so Windows paths and escaped quotes don't confuse it), replaces bare `{{var}}` interpolations with quoted sentinel tokens (`"__BRUNO_INTERP_N__"`), and returns `{ masked, vars }`. In-string variables are left untouched.
- `unmaskJsonInterpolations(maskedString, vars)` — replaces each **full quoted sentinel** with its original bare token, so bare-value/key variables come back unquoted while in-string ones keep their quotes. Matching the whole quoted token avoids corrupting literal content that merely resembles a sentinel.
- `mergeJsonValues` — recursive object/array merge with user-wins / drop-user-only / add-spec-only semantics; array-of-primitives kept as-is, empty user array takes the spec template.
- `mergeJsonBody` — masks both sides into a **shared** vars space (so sentinel indices never collide), merges, re-serializes, restores `{{var}}`; returns user body verbatim on unparseable JSON, `specBody` when `preserveValues=false`.
- `mergeFieldListPreserving` — name-matched (positional for dupes) field merge, preserving user value/enabled, file value arrays, and spec `enabled` fallback.
- `mergeAuth` — mode-gated merge with defensive clone; user-only fields retained.
- `mergeBody` — dispatches by mode (json/formUrlEncoded/graphql/raw), spec on mismatch.

**Updated existing functions:**
- `mergeSpecIntoRequest` — new `options` signature (`preserveValues`, `fullReset`), URL always from spec, body/params/headers/auth via the merge helpers, script/tests/assertions always preserved. Internal callers (`{ fullReset: true }` and default) remain compatible.
- `compareRequestFields` — removed the auth-config comparison so matching auth modes yield `hasDiff=false`; a mode difference now pushes the exact string `'auth'`.

**Exported** all nine functions via `module.exports._test`.

I verified every function against the spec with a standalone script (electron mocked), and all assertions passed. Only the source file was modified — no test files touched.
